_comentario: Perguntas enviadas ao juiz (Jev ou Laya) para cada issue. Pode editar: mude textos, remova ou acrescente perguntas. Tipos: choice (escolhe uma opção), score (nível ordenado, de 0 ao último), noul (probabilidade 0-1 de a afirmação ser verdadeira). Os textos ficam em inglês porque as issues estão em inglês. Base: Quality User Story framework (Lucassen et al.) e INVEST, citados em Iqbal et al. (2024) e Quattrocchi et al. (2026).

issue_type.instructions: What kind of work item is this?

criteria.user_story: Describes new functionality from the point of view of a user or customer
criteria.bug: Reports a defect, error or unexpected behavior that must be fixed
criteria.technical_task: Internal engineering work such as refactoring, infrastructure, build, tests or dependency updates
criteria.improvement: Changes or enhances functionality that already exists
criteria.other: A question, discussion, documentation work, or something that fits none of the above

goal_clarity.instructions: How clearly does the work item state what has to be done?
criteria: Unclear: a developer could not tell what change is expected
Partially clear: the goal can be understood, but only by making assumptions
Clear: the expected change is stated explicitly

estimability.instructions: Does the work item contain enough information for a development team to estimate its effort?
criteria: Insufficient: essential information to estimate the work is missing
Partial: some useful information, but important details are missing
Sufficient: enough detail to estimate the effort with reasonable confidence

scope_size.instructions: How large and well-bounded is the scope of work described?
criteria: Small and well-bounded: a single, focused change
Large or open-ended: many features or an epic-sized effort

has_acceptance_criteria.instructions: The work item states acceptance criteria or explains how to verify that it is done

is_ambiguous.instructions: The work item uses vague or ambiguous wording that different developers could interpret in different ways

overall_quality.instructions: Overall, how good is this work item as input for a development team that must estimate its effort?
criteria: Very poor: almost no usable information
Poor: the main goal is hard to understand and key details are missing
Fair: understandable, but with important gaps or vague parts
Good: clear, with only minor gaps
